status: frozen 9 Nov 2026, before any HSCodeComp prediction

dataset.path_root: data root (~/data/hs-rag-classifier); never in the repo, never re-hosted
dataset.label: hs_code zero-padded to 10 digits, then cut to HS6 at load; US digits 7-10 are never stored

inputs.hscodecomp_c: title, then 'Category: ' + English category levels lv1 > lv2 > ... (a level already in the path is dropped), then 'Attributes: ' + 'key: value; ...' in the file's order, blank values and drop_keys removed; lines joined by newlines; the Attributes line is left out when nothing remains

text_repair: none: mojibake is left as it is
blank_values_note: compared after stripping whitespace; 'None' and 'No' are kept because they state a fact (e.g. 'Metals Type: None', 'Whether waterproof: No')

drop_keys.Package size - length (cm): package dimension (shipping box), not the goods
drop_keys.Package size - width (cm): package dimension (shipping box), not the goods
drop_keys.Package size - height (cm): package dimension (shipping box), not the goods
drop_keys.Package size: package dimension (shipping box), not the goods
drop_keys.Package Size: package dimension (shipping box), not the goods
drop_keys.Package Dimensions: package dimension (shipping box), not the goods
drop_keys.PRODUCT_UNIT: platform sales-unit field (upper-case variant of Measurement unit), logistics
drop_keys.LOT_NUM: units per lot (upper-case variant of each pack), logistics
drop_keys.PACKAGE_TYPE: sell-by type (upper-case variant of Sold in), logistics
drop_keys.Origin: country of origin; origin does not decide the HS6
drop_keys.CN: Chinese province of origin; origin does not decide the HS6
drop_keys.Hign-concerned Chemical: platform compliance flag, almost always 'None'; not a product fact

Brand Name.reason: empty-brand placeholder; a real brand name is kept

kept_ambiguous.Package: may name the contents or the box; kept
kept_ambiguous.Packing: may name the contents or the box; kept
kept_ambiguous.Packing Method: may describe the goods' own packing; kept
kept_ambiguous.Pack: may be a count or a contents description; kept
kept_ambiguous.pack: may be a count or a contents description; kept
kept_ambiguous.Package Include: lists the goods in the set (product fact); kept
kept_ambiguous.Package Includes: lists the goods in the set (product fact); kept
kept_ambiguous.Package List: lists the goods in the set (product fact); kept
kept_ambiguous.Item Weight: weight of the goods (product fact); kept
kept_ambiguous.NET WT: net weight of the goods; kept
kept_ambiguous.Net Weight: net weight of the goods; kept
kept_ambiguous.Quantity: may be the pieces in a set; kept
kept_ambiguous.quantity: may be the pieces in a set; kept
kept_ambiguous.Quantity:: may be the pieces in a set; kept
kept_ambiguous.Brand Name: kept when it holds a real brand
